method: Reviewed full draft against official Korea Energy Agency (KEA), Korea Electrical Safety Corporation (KESCO), and National Radio Research Agency (RRA EMF certification) guidelines. Verified power consumption (100-150W vs 250-500W vs 120-160W), monthly electricity costs (4,000-6,000 KRW vs 8,000-15,000 KRW), EMF limits (10V/m, 2mG), fire hazards on latex mattresses, and 5-7 year replacement lifespans. All facts match official documentation.
